'''Cassus Fett's Battle Armor''' was a personal suit of [[Mandalorian battle armor]] that had been designed for and worn by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior and tactician [[Cassus Fett]] prior to the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Fett presumably wore this armor at the [[Battle of Jaga's Cluster]], when he killed the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]—an action that earned him infamy across the galaxy. After his apparent death, his armor was then acquired by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] dealer and arms merchant [[Adum Larp]], who placed it for sale at 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
